title: lesquerella kingii var. sherwoodii
intro: Lesquerella kingii var. sherwoodii, commonly known as Sherwood's bladderpod, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to alleviate conditions such as arthritis and skin damage. The therapeutic actions of Sherwood's bladderpod include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer activities, which are thought to be attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, particularly lesquerelin, which have been identified as responsible for its therapeutic effects.
